item.title: A message from Mrs. Longval:
item.description: Attention STA students! Today is the LAST DAY to register your Grades 9–12 team for Wednesday's Movember Dodgeball Tournament! All completed registration forms and team registration fees must be submitted to Mrs. Longval by the end of the day TODAY! If you have any questions, please stop by the weight room at lunch to see Mrs. Longval. 🥸 MOVEMBER TIP OF THE DAY! Did you know that something as simple as checking in on a friend can make a real difference in their mental health? This Movember, take a moment to ask a friend, teammate or family member how they're really doing. Sometimes the most important thing you can do is simply listen. Remember, supporting men's mental health doesn't always require a big gesture. Sometimes it starts with a small conversation! Let's make a BIG difference - one small conversation and one dodgeball game at a time! Have a great Monday!
